## Get to know Kosrae, Where I'm from 🌴

Kosrae is a small island, only 42 square miles with a population of around 6,000 people, The island has 5 villages, Tafunsak, Walung, Lelu, Malem and Utwe . It makes up one of the four islands that make up the Federated States of Micronesia (FSM) 🇫🇲 , all part of Micronesia. although the island is small, it has great scenery. Blue oceans🌊, tall coconut trees🌴, beautiful beaches and waterfalls, which makes it feel like Paradise!

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## What makes the island Unique 🌺🌺:

Mountain structure - on the middle of the island we have mountains that shape a lady sleeping, which makes the island known as the " Island of The Sleeping Lady"

Nature everywhere - On the island of Kosrae, everywhere you look, there are tall trees that always give the " Island Vibes"

Local foods - There are many Local Foods, but the most common ones are pounded taro and banana called " Fafa " and another is the " Kosraen Soup ", made with coconut milk, rice and any choice of meat.
